en: A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a European city street lined with multi‑story historic buildings featuring ornate facades and shuttered windows. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a carriage or early vehicle is visible further down the street. At the center top of the image there is printed text identifying the location as a street in Graz named Wielandgasse.
